eng_blog.notes: The R&D blog lists multiple technical posts, including technical-backlog and global call-quality work. Jaroslav Tomeček is identified as CloudTalk Director of Engineering, and Josef Lapka as CloudTalk CPTO. Blog author-card labels are inconsistent, so this is a medium-confidence classification.
